title: Treaty of the Bogue
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Treaty of the Bogue", at revision 1360866192, opens: "The Treaty of the Bogue was an unequal treaty between the United Kingdom and China, concluded in October 1843 to supplement the previous Treaty of Nanking. The treaty's key provisions granted extraterritoriality and most favoured nation status to Britain." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q1368222, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "treaty between China and the United Kingdom, concluded in October 1843 to supplement the previous Treaty of Nanking". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
